segments.subtask: The robot arm approaches the white plug on the wooden table.
The robot arm grasps the white plug and lifts it from the table.
The robot arm moves the plug towards the power strip on the table.
The robot arm positions the plug above the power strip socket.
The robot arm inserts the plug into the power strip socket.
The robot arm releases the plug and begins to retract.
The robot arm moves away from the power strip and returns to its starting position.
